parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of a request. Generate a unique value from the client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. Possible values:

- cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).

- ap-southeast-1: Singapore.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.
